original_test_intent: Validate explicit-address uncorrectable DRAM handling for every required populated slot, including exact source attribution, the approved shutdown/restart response and verified post-boot memory integrity.
original_method: Determine whether 0xd00 is a system physical address, tool-relative offset or invalid placeholder; reserve and decode a safe address for one target slot; select one approved RAS profile; confirm errormode/errortype disposition; run one UCE under continuous OOB observation; correlate address/location/syndrome with MCA/APEI or WHEA and management records; verify bounded restart, page/slot integrity and full state restoration before separately approving another slot.
manual_activity: The FAE proves the 0xd00 address-space semantics or supplies a safe target page, selects the profile, performs one UCE, owns OOB restart/recovery and restores injection, HDT and BIOS state.
required_inputs: Meaning and validity of address 0xd00 for this tool revision
Per-slot UMC/channel/rank topology, explicit-address decoder and safe pinned page
Expected UCE event, shutdown trigger, restart/boot deadlines and per-slot evidence
Backup, persistent-poison handling, abort, OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up ECC SUT with independent OOB console/power/reimage path
Do not inject 0xd00 until its address space and owned DRAM mapping are proven
One target only per approval; do not automatically continue after shutdown/restart
Abort on wrong slot, unexpected severity, boot loop, persistent poison, missing console or degraded memory
No automatic retry/recovery; disable injection and restore/diff all RAS state
agent_execution_scope: Validate address ownership/translation, profile, tool provenance, restart oracle and recovery readiness
Collect read-only transcript, console, OS/BMC event, boot and memory-integrity evidence
Do not choose address/profile, change BIOS/HDT, inject, restart/reimage/retry, advance slots or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve address-space interpretation and per-slot target
Supervise one destructive checkpoint and recovery

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a pinned decoded page for one slot and treat its UCE/restart as a standalone destructive checkpoint with console and post-boot integrity evidence.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: 0xd00 may not denote normal DRAM; a wrong UCE target can affect firmware/reserved memory, create persistent poison or prevent reboot.

project_override_considerations: If 0xd00 is a documented tool-relative offset, record its selected UMC base and physical-slot mapping. If it is a system address, substitute only an owned decoded page through an approved execution package while preserving the Master literal.

Full UCE command, exact address/location/syndrome and management evidence
Continuous shutdown/restart/boot timeline and post-boot memory integrity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row claims Memory slot 1~N but supplies one unexplained address 0xd00 with no UMC/slot binding after enumeration. Two profiles conflict on corrected-counter enable, timeout is absent, Windows conflicts with dmesg, and the restart oracle lacks timing and relation to uncorrectable severity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The explicit-address UCE and restart purpose are recognizable. Engineering can define address space, targets, profile and disposition, so static review completes while execution is gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 46 Wistron-System RAS-00766-V002: define whether 0xd00 is a system address, tool offset or defect and provide a safe pinned address-to-slot/UMC/rank map for each target; decide DRAM-versus-MCA profile; approve AMD tool/spec provenance and dramecc errormode=1/mcapolling=0/errortype=1 semantics, exact UCE and shutdown/restart deadlines, Linux/Windows/BMC evidence, persistent-poison cleanup, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Turns an unexplained low-address UCE into a traceable one-slot destructive checkpoint with explicit restart, poison cleanup and boot-integrity requirements.
independent_technical_reasoning: Address 0xd00 is below the conventional first page boundary and therefore cannot be trusted as ordinary OS-owned DRAM without tool-specific offset semantics. An uncorrectable injection may terminate access before host logs flush, so OOB console and BMC/UEFI evidence are primary, with post-boot records used for correlation. Shutdown/restart is meaningful only with a deadline and confirmation that recovery was platform containment rather than an uncontrolled boot failure. Each further slot is a new destructive action.
